evals.prompt: A notification platform supports email, SMS, and push; plain and rich templates; and normal or urgent delivery policy. The code is currently grouped into controllers/, services/, helpers/, and providers/. Propose a package structure that makes these independent choices obvious and explain how a new variant is placed.
assertions: Identifies independent domain axes such as channel, template, and delivery policy instead of preserving technical layer directories
Uses one directory per axis with bare, symmetric variant leaves such as channel/email and channel/sms rather than tool or manager names
Explains that a new answer adds a leaf under its owning axis without editing unrelated axis variants

evals.prompt: A media-processing service has several decoders, storage destinations, and thumbnail strategies. Structured audit logging and a fail-closed content policy must run for every possible combination. Should logging and policy become more sibling variant directories?
assertions: States that logging and the universal policy are cross-cutting concerns rather than selectable axes or sibling variants
Recommends applying them once around the composed operation rather than duplicating them inside every decoder, destination, or thumbnail leaf
Distinguishes the all-combination concern from a localized bridge between two specific variants

evals.prompt: An importer has JSON, CSV, and XML parsers plus database, queue, and object-storage destinations. Every parser currently contains destination-specific branches. How should the module boundaries change so parser and destination choices can evolve independently?
assertions: Separates parser/format and destination into independent axes rather than creating one module per parser-destination combination
Uses a neutral value or shared contract between the axes so neither axis names the other's concrete leaves
Places any genuine one-pair exception in the dependent variant as a localized bridge instead of a new top-level combined package

evals.prompt: A web request path and a background worker both send the same notification types, but one calls the folders transports/templates while the other calls them senders/messages. Reorganize the naming without forcing their implementations to be identical.
assertions: Uses the same stable axis vocabulary for both consumers, such as channel and template, while allowing their implementation details to differ
Names sibling variants with the same grammar and level of abstraction
Moves concepts shared by both consumers to an appropriate shared owner instead of silently duplicating divergent names
